commands.command:
set -eu
cfg=/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-remote-access.conf
if [ -e "$cfg" ]; then
  printf 'refusing_to_overwrite=%s\n' "$cfg" >&2
  exit 20
fi
tmp_cfg=$(mktemp /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/.remote-access.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$tmp_cfg"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf '%s\n' '# Restrict SSH logins to approved local group members.' 'AllowGroups remote-access' > "$tmp_cfg"
chown root:root "$tmp_cfg"
chmod 0644 "$tmp_cfg"
mv "$tmp_cfg" "$cfg"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
restorecon "$cfg" 2>/dev/null || true
if ! /usr/sbin/sshd -t; then
  rm -f "$cfg"
  exit 21
fi
systemctl reload sshd
printf 'config='; stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' "$cfg"
printf 'directive='; grep -E '^[[:space:]]*AllowGroups[[:space:]]' "$cfg"
printf 'effective='; /usr/sbin/sshd -T | grep '^allowgroups '
printf 'active='; systemctl is-active sshd
commands.stdout:

directive=AllowGroups remote-access
effective=allowgroups remote-access
active=active

commands.command:
set -eu
tracker=/run/infraset-remote-access-test.path
probe=accessdeniedprobe
if [ -e "$tracker" ]; then
  printf 'existing_test_tracker=%s\n' "$tracker" >&2
  exit 30
fi
if id "$probe" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  printf 'probe_user_already_exists=%s\n' "$probe" >&2
  exit 31
fi
test_dir=$(mktemp -d /run/infraset-remote-access.XXXXXX)
chmod 0700 "$test_dir"
printf '%s\n' "$test_dir" > "$tracker"
chmod 0600 "$tracker"
ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -C infraset-remote-access-check -f "$test_dir/key"
useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash "$probe"
probe_pw=$(openssl rand -base64 36)
printf '%s:%s\n' "$probe" "$probe_pw" | chpasswd
unset probe_pw
for account in opsadmin "$probe"; do
  account_home=$(getent passwd "$account" | awk -F: '{print $6}')
  account_group=$(id -gn "$account")
  install -d -m 0700 -o "$account" -g "$account_group" "$account_home/.ssh"
  auth_file=$account_home/.ssh/authorized_keys
  if [ -e "$auth_file" ]; then
    cp -a "$auth_file" "$test_dir/$account.authorized_keys.original"
    printf '%s\n' yes > "$test_dir/$account.had_authorized_keys"
  else
    printf '%s\n' no > "$test_dir/$account.had_authorized_keys"
  fi
  printf '\n%s\n' "$(cat "$test_dir/key.pub")" >> "$auth_file"
  chown "$account:$account_group" "$auth_file"
  chmod 0600 "$auth_file"
  restorecon -R "$account_home/.ssh" 2>/dev/null || true
done
printf 'test_key='; ssh-keygen -lf "$test_dir/key.pub"
printf 'allowed_identity='; id opsadmin
printf 'denied_probe_identity='; id "$probe"
printf 'tracker_ready=%s\n' "$tracker"
commands.stdout:

allowed_identity=uid=1000(opsadmin) gid=1001(opsadmin) groups=1001(opsadmin),1000(remote-access)
denied_probe_identity=uid=1001(accessdeniedprobe) gid=1002(accessdeniedprobe) groups=1002(accessdeniedprobe)
